content_blocks.markdown:
**Arguments**
```json
{
  "function": "() => {
  const text = document.body.innerText;
  
  // Find Today's sales
  const salesMatch = text.match(/今日全球销售额[\s\S]{1,50}?US\$[\d,.]+/);
  const unitsMatch = text.match(/(\d+)\s*件商品/);
  
  // Find cards
  const cards = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[class*="card"], [class*="Card"], [class*="widget"], [class*="Widget"], [data-testid*="card"]')).map(c => c.innerText.trim()).filter(t => t.includes('销售') || t.includes('订单') || t.includes('US$'));

  return {
    salesMatch: salesMatch ? salesMatch[0] : null,
    unitsMatch: unitsMatch ? unitsMatch[0] : null,
    cardsCount: cards.length,
    textSnippet: text.slice(text.indexOf('我的业务'), text.indexOf('我的业务') + 1500)
  };
}",
  "pageId": 3,
  "waitForStableDom": false
}
```
